{"items":[{"item_id":"h071","prompts":["I'm choosing between five laptop configurations. Weight (kg) and battery life (hours) are: A: 2.1, 5; B: 1.4, 8; C: 1.8, 7; D: 2.3, 9; E: 1.9, 6. I want to be as light as possible AND have the longest battery. Which options are actually worth considering, i.e., not dominated by another option on both criteria? Show the reasoning."],"rubric":["Correctly identifies the dominated options (A, C, E) and the non-dominated ones (B and D)","Explains that a point is dominated when another option is at least as good on both objectives and better on one","Final answer is consistent with the data provided"]},{"item_id":"h072","prompts":["I scanned a machine part and the STL has a bunch of tiny floating bits from dust and stray reflections. The main body should be one connected solid of roughly 50,000+ mm^3, but there are small fragments too. Analyze this mesh: separate the connected pieces, report how many components there are and their volumes, and tell me which ones to keep vs. discard as scan debris. Assume the file is at scans/part_v3.stl."],"rubric":["Describes separating the mesh into connected components and measuring each component's volume","Provides a rule for filtering debris (e.g., volume threshold) and applies it to identify the main body","Reports the number of components and their volumes as the expected output"]},{"item_id":"h073","prompts":["I need to research and summarize how the top 5 open-source web frameworks compare on performance, ecosystem, and learning curve. This is a big multi-step job — before diving in, set up a working plan with task files so we can track findings and progress across the session, then carry out the research."],"rubric":["Creates planning/tracking files (e.g., a task plan, findings, and progress notes) before doing the research","The plan breaks the work into concrete steps covering at least the comparison dimensions mentioned","Final answer includes an actual comparison of the frameworks, not just the plan"]},{"item_id":"h074","prompts":["A useful clarifying comment I left on issue #432 got hidden/minimized by a moderator by mistake and the info is now invisible to the reporter. Restore it so the discussion shows it again."],"rubric":["Recognizes the need to unhide/unminimize a hidden issue comment","References the correct issue number (#432)","Does not request credentials or perform actions requiring private accounts beyond stating the intent"]},{"item_id":"h075","prompts":["My Documents folder is a mess: files named 'final_v2.docx', 'Untitled(3).pdf', 'report final FINAL.docx' scattered everywhere, plus I think I have duplicate photos. Here's the listing:

final_v2.docx
report final FINAL.docx
notes.txt
Untitled(3).pdf
resume2023.pdf
resume_2023.pdf
scan001.jpg
vacation.jpg
vacation (copy).jpg

Organize these into a sensible structure, flag likely duplicates, and suggest a cleanup plan."],"rubric":["Proposes a clear folder structure grouping the listed files logically","Identifies the likely duplicate pairs (resume files, vacation photos, final/report docs)","Provides rename suggestions removing the messy naming patterns"]},{"item_id":"h076","prompts":["I'm porting an HarmonyOS app to Android with ArkUI-X and I need the ToolBar component to work on the Android side. I've heard some components come as ABC and some as SO and I'm not sure which this is or how to wire up the NAPI registration and build config. Walk me through adapting it, including what to put in BUILD.gn and the plugin registration file."],"rubric":["Explains how to determine whether the component is ABC-based or SO-based","Includes NAPI registration code (or its structure) for the component on the cross-platform side","Covers BUILD.gn configuration and registration in plugin_lib.gni / build configs","Specifically addresses the ToolBar component in the ArkUI-X Android context"]},{"item_id":"h077","prompts":["Fetch the README.md from the main branch of the vercel/next.js repository on GitHub and give me a two-sentence summary of what the project is."],"rubric":["Retrieves the README.md content from vercel/next.js on the main branch","Provides an accurate short summary of the project based on the actual README content"]},{"item_id":"h078","prompts":["I just finished a batch of video compressions and want a structured JSON summary. Here's the data: total original duration 3600s, total compressed duration 3540s. Segment 1: input 25MB, output 10MB, 1200s. Segment 2: input 40MB, output 15MB, 2400s. Build the report with per-segment details, compression ratios, and overall duration stats."],"rubric":["Output is valid JSON with a clear structure covering segments, compression ratios, and duration statistics","Compression ratios are computed correctly (e.g., 2.5 and ~2.67) from the given sizes","Includes overall duration statistics (original 3600s, compressed 3540s)"]},{"item_id":"h079","prompts":["During our repo review we minimized the body of my review on PR #118 to keep the timeline clean, but now we want that feedback visible for the audit. Bring that review text back out of hidden state."],"rubric":["Recognizes the need to unhide/unminimize a pull request review body","References PR #118 specifically","Does not require private credentials or paid services to describe the intent"]},{"item_id":"h080","prompts":["I have a clip meeting_recording.mp4 and I need just the audio as a WAV file so I can run some loudness/energy analysis on it afterwards. Pull the audio track out for me and tell me the output file."],"rubric":["Extracts audio from the video into WAV format (e.g., via ffmpeg)","Names a concrete output file (e.g., meeting_recording.wav)","Does not require private accounts or paid services"]}]}
